Rules
The purpose of the game is to score more points than the king. Build a horizontal, vertical or diagonal line of five or more balls of the same color to clear them and score points. Six in a row clears the entire line; seven or more clears every ball of that color on the board. Move balls across vacant squares to form these lines. We wish you success.
